# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight lad with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Emotionless in demeanor, Barney possesses very little capacity for chatter or laughter and suffers from an agonizing inability to maintain a conversation. Despite his awkwardness, he holds vast admiration for Nell and feels immense pride when accompanying her, though he is easily overcome by shyness and dread when faced with high society or grand company.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Overweight  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Taciturn  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Shy  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a carriage team  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Barney drove a double-seated buggy to carry his sister Odette, Nell, and Isolde to a concert at the Pale Sands Hotel. Prior to the ride, he insisted that Nell sit beside him on the front seat, taking great pride in her presence despite his inability to converse beyond smirking and laughing softly. Upon arriving at the hotel, he fled out of sheer dread of being invited to join the formal supper in the dining hall. Nevertheless, he faithfully waited outside with his team and drove the girls home after the event concluded.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
